test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The volume and height of a cylinder are 8470 cm³ and 2.2 cm, respectively. Find the radius (in cm) of the cylinder. Use pi = (22)/(7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly apply **r² = Volume ÷ (π × h)**.

r² = 8470 ÷ ((22/7) × 2.2)

r² = (8470 × 7) ÷ (22 × 2.2) = (8470 × 7) ÷ 48.4 = 1225.

r = √1225 = 35 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Volume (V)** = 8470 cm³

**Height (h)** = 2.2 cm

**π** = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

**Volume of Cylinder** = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5183cf09d9cb34e0934924bcdf58127aeca68e323ee628d89c70b4864f7b94fb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 8470 = (22/7) × r² × 2.2

⇒ 8470 = (22 × 2.2 / 7) × r²

⇒ 8470 = (48.4 / 7) × r²

⇒ r² = (8470 × 7) ÷ 48.4

⇒ r² = 59290 ÷ 48.4

⇒ r² = 1225

⇒ r = √1225

⇒ r = 35 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 35 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Cylinder

The lateral area excluding the top and bottom bases: CSA = 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cylinder

The sum of the CSA and the area of the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of Hollow Cylinder

The volume of the material between two concentric cylinders: V = π(R² − r²)h.</p
